scope: Primary control-panel category for all 62 inserted HRA-derived structures in the reconstructed female model, including both regenerated breast envelopes.
policy: Categories group anatomical assemblies, not every tissue function. Each mesh has one primary system toggle; chest presets and explicit selection further affect visibility.
notes: The two regenerated envelopes are already members of the 62 inserted IDs; there are not 64 inserted structures.
Breast suspensory supports remain in the mammary assembly even though their rendering material uses the connective-tissue color.
Ovaries remain in the reproductive assembly despite having endocrine functions. Uterine/ovarian ligaments and peritoneal folds remain associated with reproductive anatomy.
Uterovesical pouch is an organ-associated peritoneal recess, not a urinary organ. Its reproductive assembly assignment does not classify it as glandular or contractile tissue.
Nipple, areola and areolar tubercles are optional surface structures under Body surface; they are not contractile skeletal muscles.
